risk_notes: Requires macOS Full Disk Access; highly sensitive message database

name: Google Chat MCP
capability_summary: Interact with Google Chat spaces, messages and members
risk_notes: Requires OAuth 2.0 credentials and token files; protect tokens and message content

name: whatsapp-mcp-server
capability_summary: Read/send WhatsApp messages, media and groups; unanswered-message reminders
risk_notes: Session data and message content are sensitive; use dedicated account and encrypted storage

name: AutoPentest
capability_summary: OWASP WSTG-oriented web application testing with 27 security tools
risk_notes: Authorized targets only; Docker and tool execution increase blast radius

name: Vulnerable MCP Server
capability_summary: Intentionally vulnerable server for security testing, education and CTFs
risk_notes: Never expose to production or untrusted networks; use isolated lab only

name: Penetration Testing MCP Server
capability_summary: Authorized penetration testing with CVE monitoring and Nuclei integration
risk_notes: Authorized assets only; review nuclei templates and command execution permissions

name: Report Builder MCP Server
capability_summary: Email templates; HTML reports; executive summaries; quality validation; branding
risk_notes: Remote service may receive report content; review endpoint and retention policy

name: MCP Vulnerability Reporting
column8: template content and report retention before deployment

name: Code Auditor
capability_summary: TypeScript/JavaScript audit for SOLID, DRY, code health and security patterns
risk_notes: Review source and repository permissions before exposing proprietary code

name: Actionlint MCP
capability_summary: GitHub Actions syntax checking with optional shellcheck and pyflakes
risk_notes: May execute or inspect workflow-related commands; isolate CI credentials

name: Code Review MCP
capability_summary: GitHub PR diffs; project docs; static/security/tests; inline comments; Markdown report
risk_notes: Requires GitHub token; use least privilege and confirm before posting comments

name: iOS Simulator MCP Server
capability_summary: List simulators; inspect accessibility tree; tap; type; swipe; screenshot; record video; install and launch apps
risk_notes: Requires macOS and Xcode simulator; use version 1.3.3 or later; isolate test data and credentials

name: Mobile MCP
capability_summary: Platform-agnostic automation for iOS simulators, Android emulators and real devices; app lifecycle; UI interaction; screenshots; recordings; crash reports
risk_notes: Requires Xcode tools for iOS and Android SDK/ADB for Android; restrict device access and sensitive data

name: Android-MCP
capability_summary: ADB-based Android device and emulator interaction with UI actions
risk_notes: ADB can perform arbitrary UI actions; use controlled emulators or test devices and isolate secrets

name: Android MCP Server
capability_summary: Control Android emulators and devices via ADB; inspect, interact with and debug apps
risk_notes: Requires ADB and authorized device access; limit shell/device permissions and avoid production accounts

name: Google Threat Intelligence MCP
capability_summary: Query VirusTotal GTI for threat collections, malware, files, domains, IPs, URLs, IOC and timelines
risk_notes: Requires VT_APIKEY; protect API key and review data-sharing

name: OpenCTI MCP Server
capability_summary: Query OpenCTI reports, malware, indicators, threat actors, campaigns and STIX objects
risk_notes: Requires OpenCTI URL and API token; never commit credentials; enforce tenant and role-based access

name: FastMCP Threat Intelligence
capability_summary: Self-hosted threat-intelligence workflows exposed through MCP tools
column9: sample handling and access controls before production use
